sources.title: Tietjen et al. (2010), Effects of climate change on the coupled dynamics of water and vegetation in drylands
sources.access: Full author PDF via web; model description, growth and climate scenarios inspected.

sources.title: Peters (2002), Plant species dominance at a grassland-shrubland ecotone
sources.access: USDA author publication summary; original Jornada PDF403. Specific active-growth findings are from the supplied local code, not attributed as exact paper reproduction.

sources.title: Palmquist et al. (2018), STEPWAT2
sources.access: Full publisher article: resource partitioning, annual growth and mortality. Separately inspected pinned code.

sources.title: Taubert et al. (2020), The role of species traits for grassland productivity
sources.access: Primary article search-indexed methods: daily individuals without subpatch locations; Festuca parameterization. No Jornada coefficient transfer.

sources.title: Williams and Albertson (2005), Contrasting short- and long-timescale effects of vegetation dynamics on water and carbon fluxes in water-limited ecosystems
sources.access: Full publisher text; overview, grass/wood distinctions and AppendixB carbon balances. Image equations not transcribed; proposed LEAF equations explicitly separate.

sources.title: Caylor et al. (2004), Relationship between small-scale structural variability and simulated vegetation productivity across a regional moisture gradient in southern Africa
sources.access: Publisher abstract and author lab record; detailed physiology equations not verified.

sources.title: Caylor and Shugart (2004), Simulated productivity of heterogeneous patches in Southern African savanna landscapes using a canopy productivity model
sources.access: Publisher abstract, author lab record and author-uploaded full-text search excerpt. Limit conclusions to daily patch productivity and canopy heterogeneity; no detailed shared-code claim.

sources.title: Caylor et al. (2005), Tree canopy effects on simulated water stress in southern African savannas
sources.access: Publisher abstract: daily energy/water balance, five surface components and moisture stress. Full methods subscription-only.

sources.title: Caylor et al. (2006), On the ecohydrology of structurally heterogeneous semiarid landscapes
sources.access: Full publisher article; canopy/root overlap statistics and water/stress, not an individual biomass-update engine.

sources.title: FAO AquaCrop calculation scheme
sources.access: Full official scheme: daily canopy/transpiration/aboveground biomass; normalize water productivity for climate/CO2.

sources.title: de Roos et al. (2021), Performance analysis of regional AquaCrop(v6.1) biomass and surface soil moisture simulations
sources.access: Primary application/methods eq1 B=WP*sum(Tr/ETo). FAO full book too large for web, manual chapter3 timed out; not claimed read.

method: Primary sources only; explicit full-text/access distinctions. Public code GET manifest in public_sources/manifest.json.
